comparison.objective: Plant and backfill a delicate pepper seedling so its root plug is level, upright, evenly surrounded, firm, and undamaged; the candidate instead sets and locks a robot-gripper opening stop and verifies retained motion.
comparison.physical_skill: Seedling planting requires holding a fragile root plug while distributing and firming granular material without damaging the stem or leaves. The candidate requires coaxial driver and wrench seating, coupled screw–jam-nut countertorque, tool withdrawal, and articulated test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2106 grades plug tilt/depth, four-sided soil level, hole fill, firmness under a side push, spill, release, and plant damage. The candidate grades 90° opening accuracy, nut retention, three repeat cycles, stop drift, tool/hand clearance, and hardware or fixture loss. All available versions provide numeric thresholds; no material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: The shared need for bimanual stabilization is generic; granular backfilling around a fragile plant tests materially different manipulation and outcomes from preserving a mechanical adjustment while locking a jam nut and verifying cyclic retention.
